title: eat, shit & die 276
author: bpatrick
html: So I was searching online for mentions of the site (because I’m the scummy kind of person who would do that) and this awesome person mentioned she was “into” the site, which was unexpected and amazing, and then she said she loves it when the comics have African-American women in them because she loves to see characters like herself represented. So a normal person would think that this would apply across the board and work to up the diversity represented in general, but I’m just going to draw a bunch of African-American women because I’m not that bright.
